both_hands.name: both_hands
both_hands.description: Both hands present and valid pose; 2D torso anchor, unshifted z.

left_only.name: left_only
left_only.description: Left hand present, right hand null; right hand features NaN.

right_only.name: right_only
right_only.description: Right hand present, left hand null; left hand features NaN.

no_hands.name: no_hands
no_hands.description: Both hands null, pose present; hands NaN, pose normalized.

no_pose.name: no_pose
no_pose.description: No pose present; all 177 features NaN.

left_dominant.name: left_dominant
left_dominant.description: 3-frame sequence where left hand moves more; left dominant, canonicalized with hand and pose pair swaps.

shoulders_swapped.name: shoulders_swapped
shoulders_swapped.description: Shoulders inverted in space; 2D width remains positive norm and normalized accordingly.

zero_shoulder_width.name: zero_shoulder_width
zero_shoulder_width.description: Zero shoulder width produces all NaNs to prevent division by zero.

aspect_ratio_scaling.name: aspect_ratio_scaling
aspect_ratio_scaling.description: Applies aspect_ratio (1.5) to x coordinates before 2D shoulder normalization.

head_anchors.name: head_anchors
head_anchors.description: Full upper-body + head pose anchors (pose 0..16) normalized by shoulder width.

missing_shoulders_eye_fallback.name: missing_shoulders_eye_fallback
missing_shoulders_eye_fallback.description: Missing shoulders trigger eye-distance (2<->5) * 6.0 fallback scale and eye midpoint origin.
